set-variable.name: validatedGraphUrl

return-response.set-body: @(new JObject(new JProperty("type", "about:blank"), new JProperty("title", "Invalid Graph tool arguments."), new JProperty("status", 400), new JProperty("code", (string)context.Variables["validatedGraphUrl"])).ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None))

set-variable.name: shapedGraphResponse

return-response.set-body: @(new JObject(new JProperty("type", "about:blank"), new JProperty("title", "Graph response violates the bounded tool contract; no content was truncated."), new JProperty("status", 502), new JProperty("code", (string)context.Variables["shapedGraphResponse"])).ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None))

set-variable.name: graphRetryAfter
